a: PROJECT WORKS WITH LOW-INCOME, POTENTIAL FIRST-GENERATION, OR AT HIGH RISK OF ACADEMIC FAILURE STUDENTS TO IMPROVE THEIR ACADEMIC SKILLS & MOTIVATION TO ENTER & COMPLETE A POSTSECONDARY PROGRAM.
THE BIG BEND COMMUNITY COLLEGE (BBCC) HIGH SCHOOL EQUIVALENCY PROGRAM (HEP) PROJECT WILL SUPPORT 60 STUDENTS PER YEAR TO EARN A HIGH SCHOOL DIPLOMA EQUIVALENT.
THE PROJECT WILL FOCUS ON DEVELOPING A COMPREHENSIVE OUTREACH MODEL FOR ENROLLING, RETAINING, AND COMPLETING HISPANIC AND UNDERSERVED STUDENTS, ESPECIALLY IN RURAL AREAS OF THE COLLEGE'S DISTRICT.
